correctness.rationale: For every 1<=m<n, the signed four-frequency zero-sum classification leaves 2+2 cancellations and, only at n=3m, the 3m=m+m+m cubic term. Normalizing the full real sine/cosine planes gives the exact quartic. For n!=3m its one-variable H_u(x) is 3/2+3(2u-1)x+(3/2)(u^2-4u+1)x^2, maximized at pure lower mode for u<=1/2 and interior x*=(2u-1)/(4u-1-u^2) otherwise. For n=3m cubic R_u(z) has one sign change and R_u(0)<0<R_u(infinity), hence one positive maximizer with phase beta=3alpha. The exact derivative identity and resultant factorization with a Sturm-isolated root in (0.719,0.720) were independently checked; strictly positive Poisson kernel and Jensen give monotone norm and uniqueness of contraction time. The quantifiers exclude rho=0 equality classification and complex inputs.
